steps.name: preflight
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git fetch --prune origin; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse origin/develop); echo MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main)

steps.name: sync-release-baseline
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path

p = Path('platformio.ini')
s = p.read_text()
old = '-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.0\\"'
new = '-DAPP_VERSION=\\"1.0.1\\"'
if s.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one APP_VERSION 1.0.0, found {s.count(old)}')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new, 1))

p = Path('github.md')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '- Nie nadpisuj ani nie cofaj lokalnych zmian uzytkownika bez wyraznej prosby.\n'
addition = '''- Nie merguj `main` z powrotem do `develop` tylko po to, aby zsynchronizowac snapshot wydania.\n- Po wydaniu zsynchronizuj do `develop` tylko metadane bazowej wersji (np. `APP_VERSION` i wersje pakietu), jesli release podbil je wylacznie na `main`.\n- Rozbieznosc historii `main` i `develop` jest oczekiwana w tym modelu: `main` przechowuje snapshoty wydan, a `develop` szczegolowa historie rozwoju.\n'''
if addition.strip() not in s:
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('github.md policy anchor not found')
    p.write_text(s.replace(anchor, anchor + addition, 1))

p = Path('AGENTS.md')
s = p.read_text()
anchor = '- Set `work_branch` explicitly. Follow MatrixHub Git policy: normal development is on `develop`; `main` is the stable release line unless the user explicitly requests another branch.\n'
addition = '- For release snapshots and post-release branch synchronization, follow `github.md`; do not merge `main` back into `develop` merely to import a release snapshot.\n'
if addition not in s:
    if anchor not in s:
        raise SystemExit('AGENTS.md branch-policy anchor not found')
    p.write_text(s.replace(anchor, anchor + addition, 1))
PY
cd interface; npm version 1.0.1 --no-git-tag-version --ignore-scripts >/dev/null; cd ..; test -z "$(git diff --name-only | grep -v -E '^(platformio.ini|interface/package.json|interface/package-lock.json|github.md|AGENTS.md)$' || true)"; git diff --check; git diff --stat

steps.name: install-and-verify-frontend
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd interface; npm ci --ignore-scripts; npm run lint; npm run check; npm run test:run; npm run unused:check

steps.name: confirm-known-contract-debt
steps.command: set +e; cd interface; npm run ui:contract > /tmp/ui-contract.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /tmp/ui-contract.log; test $rc -ne 0 || exit 20; grep -q 'rawStyledControl: 2/0' /tmp/ui-contract.log || exit 21; grep -q 'DateSelector.svelte:92' /tmp/ui-contract.log || exit 22; grep -q 'DateSelector.svelte:111' /tmp/ui-contract.log || exit 23; exit 0

steps.name: commit-and-publish-develop
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; cd .. 2>/dev/null || true; git diff --check; test -z "$(git diff --name-only | grep -v -E '^(platformio.ini|interface/package.json|interface/package-lock.json|github.md|AGENTS.md)$' || true)"; git add platformio.ini interface/package.json interface/package-lock.json github.md AGENTS.md; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Sync develop with 1.0.1 release baseline'; git fetch origin develop; test "$(git rev-parse origin/develop)" = "e4a8f31288eb7f000643cecdd6c5351510a89ce6"; git push origin HEAD:develop; echo NEW_DEVELOP=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
